topic: Adjusting traffic forecasting and data environment
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies in reported traffic, particularly low numbers (around 1000–2000) during nighttime hours for Brazilian locations. It was noted that a placeholder/dummy value is currently active, which predicts minimum traffic of 1500+. The team discussed removing this dummy value to get more accurate data.

Regarding the technical implementation, it was determined that calculations could be performed on the 'stage' dataset. There were discussions about the relationship between production (prod), beta, and stage datasets, noting that historically, beta initially used the stage dataset before switching to prod due to data inconsistencies.

The team agreed on handling the minimum traffic threshold: setting it to 0 for now, while considering if nighttime hours might require separate processing later. The task of recalculating the metrics was accepted into work.
decisions: The dummy/placeholder value for traffic forecasting will be removed.
Calculations will be performed using the 'stage' dataset.
The minimum traffic threshold is set to 0.
action_items: Someone needs to confirm the data environment used by beta (prod vs. stage) with a specific person.
Recalculate metrics on the stage dataset, setting the lower bound to 0.
